title: Checking whether a visit is going ahead
passage:
Could you tell me whether tomorrow’s visit is still going ahead?
A. I can introduce you to tomorrow’s host.
B. I’ve put the earlier visit in my calendar.
C. The host hasn’t called it off, but she asked me not to confirm yet.
passageZh:
能告訴我明天的拜訪是否照常嗎？
A. 我可以介紹明天的主人給你認識。
B. 我把較早的那次拜訪加進行事曆了。
C. 主人還沒取消，但她請我先不要確認。
